original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚伊莫州一名青少年据称被人从楼上推下身亡，警方已确认
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚伊莫州警方确认，17岁女孩Chiamaka Chukwuokore在首府Owerri据称被一名26岁男子从两层建筑上推下后死亡。事件发生在周日，地点位于Mbonu Ejike街Ikeneagbu一带。警方发言人表示，死者身亡后，嫌疑人正面临谋杀指控。目前该消息仅来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Owerri, along Mbonu Ejike Street, Ikeneagbu, Imo State

key_facts.fact: 伊莫州警方确认17岁女孩Chiamaka Chukwuokore死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Imo State Police Command has confirmed the death of 17-year-old Chiamaka Chukwuokore

key_facts.fact: 该女孩据称被一名26岁男子从两层建筑上推下
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: who was allegedly pushed from a two-storey building by a 26-year-old man, Ifeanyi Chukwu Joseph, in Owerri

key_facts.fact: 事件发生在周日，地点为Mbonu Ejike街Ikeneagbu
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The incident occurred on Sunday, along Mbonu Ejike Street, Ikeneagbu, in the state capital

key_facts.fact: 警方称嫌疑人正面临谋杀指控
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the suspect was now facing a murder allegation

uncertainties: 推人行为目前仅为“据称”，尚未经司法证实
